topic: How to pick the right business category on Google Maps

script.hook: Wrong Google category is killing your rankings.
beats: Your primary category tells Google exactly what searches to show you in.
Pick the most specific category that matches your core service, not a broad one.
Wrong choice means competitors rank above you even when you are closer.
